children: OriginTrail has opened community input on OT-RFC-27, a proposal for a neurosymbolic marketplace where verifiable AI inference and knowledge graph queries are metered, served, and settled in TRAC between OriginTrail nodes. The proposal builds on validated prototypes and describes a service layer in which node operators supply AI and knowledge services while payments run through the network's existing token. Because the RFC process is open, the settlement model and marketplace mechanics remain subject to community discussion before any implementation.

For TRAC, the proposal outlines a demand thesis tied to AI usage rather than speculation: every metered inference or graph query would require TRAC for settlement between nodes. The scope of that demand depends on adoption of the marketplace and on how the community finalizes the settlement design, so the thesis stays provisional until the RFC closes.
OT-RFC-27: A Marketplace for Verifiable AI and Knowledge Services

title: OriginTrail: OT-RFC-27 Proposes Neurosymbolic Marketplace for Verifiable AI Services Settled in TRAC - 04 Sep 2026
